definitions.gloss: central part, middle section, central region
definitions.explanation: The middle portion of something. In Japanese geography, often refers to the Chubu region of central Honshu.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中部|ちゅうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧。
examples.english: It is located in central Japan.

examples.japanese: {中部|ちゅうぶ}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The Chubu region has many mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧{中部|ちゅうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}する→接近する：25362_sekkinsuru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The typhoon is expected to approach central Honshu starting tonight.

notes:
GEOGRAPHY:
{中部|ちゅうぶ}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ (Chubu region) covers nine prefectures in central Honshu, including {愛知|あいち}, {長野|ながの}, ⟦{新潟|にいがた}→新潟：27452_niigata⟧, {石川|いしかわ}, and {静岡|しずおか}. The Japanese Alps run through this region.

FORMS:
⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (middle) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part, section)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中部|ちゅうぶ}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: Chubu region
- {中部|ちゅうぶ}{国際空港|こくさいくうこう}: Chubu Centrair International Airport
- ⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧{中部|ちゅうぶ}: central Honshu
